## Purpose

This page keeps the [Article Skeleton](article_skeleton.qmd) and
[Model Blueprint](model_blueprint.qmd) aligned without duplicating their full
content. The article skeleton owns the reader-facing narrative. The model
blueprint owns calculation and evidence requirements. Existing model pages own
the canonical equations and quantitative assumptions.

## Working rule

When the article structure changes, update the first and last columns here.
When a component calculation changes, update the model blueprint and its
canonical page, then revise the readiness assessment here. Do not copy model
inputs into the article skeleton until the canonical component page has adopted
them.

## Current critical path

The shortest dependency-led path to the headline paper results is:

$$
\text{equipment ledger}
\rightarrow
\text{stack and BOP}
\rightarrow
\text{compression}
\rightarrow
\text{TCP collection and export}
\rightarrow
\text{central platform and installation}
\rightarrow
\text{landed yield and LCOH}.
$$

This order resolves the quantities that determine the architecture difference
before writing results or conclusions.
